# Micro App Builder

> A playbook for building production micro apps with any AI assistant on [Your Platform] (any AI-friendly app builder), inside the person's sub-account, from one prompt.

Start with the single-file playbook. It contains every doc and template below.

- [PLAYBOOK.md](https://github.com/myappz-ai/micro-app-builder/releases/latest/download/PLAYBOOK.md): everything in one file (latest release)
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/myappz-ai/micro-app-builder/main/AGENTS.md): where an AI agent starts
- [Project instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/myappz-ai/micro-app-builder/main/templates/project-instructions.md): rules for every chat
- [One prompt to a finished app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/myappz-ai/micro-app-builder/main/docs/20-one-prompt-to-app.md)
- [Integration routes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/myappz-ai/micro-app-builder/main/docs/21-integration-routes.md)
